Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
edu.najah.software.model.Vehicle
Direct Known Subclasses:
Car, ElectricVehicle, Motorcycle, Truck, Van
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object
Represents an abstract rental vehicle in the system. Serves as the base class for specific vehicle types.
